subject: gemma-3-12b-it OUT_OF_COMPETENCE verdict in ZH_G1_COMPETENCE_SCREEN.json
registered_rule: a turn counts as Chinese when Han characters are at least 0.5 of its script-bearing characters (Han + Latin letters); response_language_accuracy must be >= 0.95
finding: gemma-3-12b-it's failures are not English replies. It answers in fluent Chinese and then appends a parenthetical pinyin romanisation of the same answer. The romanisation carries roughly two to three Latin letters per Han character it transliterates, which drags the Han ratio of an otherwise Chinese turn to ~0.25 and puts it under the registered 0.5 threshold.

evidence.example_turn_head:
好的，我了解了。

您好！根据您的账号 7702-3391 的记录，系统显示今天成功收取了两笔 48 美元的直接借款…
evidence.example_turn_gloss_head:
(Hǎo de, wǒ liǎojiě le.

Nín hǎo! Gēnjù nín de zhànghào 7702-3391 de jìlù…

interpretation: Only 57 of 3450 gemma turns (1.65%) contain no Han character at all, so the checkpoint is producing Chinese in ~98% of turns. The Han-ratio LID registered for G1 cannot separate 'answered in another language' from 'answered in Chinese and also transliterated it', and gemma is the only one of the four checkpoints that transliterates. The 0.283 score is therefore a property of the instrument on this checkpoint's output style, not a measurement of Chinese competence.
threshold_not_moved: The 0.5 Han ratio and the 0.95 accuracy bar are registered in the design card and were NOT changed. ZH_G1_COMPETENCE_SCREEN.json stands as computed. The 2949/3450 gloss-stripped figure above is descriptive only: it comes from an ad-hoc regular expression written after seeing the data, it is not a second screen, and it is not used to pass gemma.
confound_still_open: gemma's zh-b0 shards were generated by the stale run_hf_generation.py and carry the English facts label 'Account and policy facts:' (see ZH_B0_METADATA_REPAIR.json). That contamination biases toward English replies, i.e. it is anti-conservative for exclusion, so it cannot explain a checkpoint that nevertheless answered in Chinese; it does mean gemma's screen arm was not run under the frozen v3 surface.
consequence_for_reporting: gemma-3-12b-it must be reported as failing the registered G1 screen, with this diagnosis attached. Any claim that gemma cannot hold a Chinese dialogue is not supported by these transcripts and must not be made.
